unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
validation: Some of the entered data is not valid.
http-400: The request could not be processed.
http-403: You do not have access to this.
http-409: That conflicts with the current state.
http-500: The server ran into a problem. Please try again later.
no-waiver-published: No liability waiver has been published yet.
waiver-birth-date-required: Add the sailor's date of birth first — it decides whether a guardian has to sign.
guardian-confirmation-needed: A sailor under 18 needs a parent or legal guardian to sign. An online confirmation on its own is not enough.
guardian-name-required: Enter the name of the guardian who signed.
waiver-already-confirmed: This sailor has already confirmed version {{required_version}} of the waiver for this competition.
waiver-confirmation-forbidden: You can only confirm the waiver for your own account.
waiver-checklist-forbidden: The check-in list is available to the event organizer and the league office.
race-not-found: This race does not belong to this matchday.
race-result-unknown-boat: Boat {{boat_number}} has no entry in this race.
race-result-invalid-code: That is not a valid result code.
race-result-position-required: Enter a finish position for boat {{boat_number}}.
race-result-redress-required: Enter the redress points awarded to boat {{boat_number}}.
race-result-duplicate-position: Finish position {{finish_position}} is used by more than one boat.
no-linked-sailor-record: No sailor record is linked to this account yet. An administrator or your club's leadership can create one and link it to your email address.
sailor-photo-not-found: This sailor has no photo yet.
sailor-photo-invalid-type: The upload must be an image.
sailor-photo-invalid: This file is not a readable image.
sailor-photo-too-large: The photo is too large. Please use a smaller file.
sailor-photo-protected: This sailor is under 18, or has no date of birth on file. Their photo is only shown to a signed-in account connected to them.
pairing-team-count-mismatch: The number of registered clubs does not match this event’s setup. Add or remove clubs until the counts agree, then draw.
pairing-catalog-missing: No pre-computed pairing list is stored for this combination of teams, boats and flights.
event-not-ready: This event's setup is incomplete. The manage panel lists what is missing.
event-boat-count-mismatch: {{configured_boats}} boats are set up, but the event is configured for {{boat_count}}.
event-dates-missing: This event has no date yet.
event-without-pairing-list: This event has no pairing list yet, so there is nothing to sail. Draw one first.
event-configuration-frozen: Racing has started ({{races_started}} races, {{results_recorded}} results), so the setup can no longer be changed. Results stay editable.
club-crest-invalid-type: That file type cannot be used as a crest. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
club-crest-invalid: That file could not be read as an image.
club-crest-too-large: The crest is too large. Please use a smaller file.
club-crest-not-yours: You can only change the crest of your own club.
club-crest-not-found: This club has no uploaded crest.
club-members-restricted-to-members: Only a club's own members can see its member list.
